caution: LG appliances must resolve the configured rethink hostname to the Home Assistant host and reach the required ThinQ ports.
Never log or commit the MQTT password; generate the runtime configuration with restrictive file permissions.
Keep manual MQTT options available because Supervisor service discovery is optional and can be unavailable when no MQTT service is registered.
The local add-on build must not depend on an anonymously inaccessible GHCR image; build from the public source branch unless the package is public.
Use the released master branch as the default add-on source; never build installations from a mutable development branch.
Shell entrypoint files must use LF; CRLF makes Linux interpret the shebang as /bin/sh\r and report the script as missing.
Use rethink.home.arpa as the default unicast DNS hostname; do not use an mDNS-only .local name for appliance provisioning.
Treat RAC pipe temperature raw values 0 and 1 as unsupported sentinels; do not publish them as implausible negative temperatures.
RAC indirect wind shares tag 0x321 with vertical swing; keep a single read-field owner and publish the derived switch state without overwriting the climate field mapping.
Keep RAC auto dry as a non-optimistic switch backed by tag 0x20e device reports; do not duplicate it as a binary sensor.
Do not publish Rethink internal MQTT port 1884 on the Home Assistant host; reserve host port 8883 for Rethink ThinQ 2 and remove any conflicting MQTT broker add-on mapping.
Preserve /data/ha-state across add-on rebuilds and updates; deleting it resets the software-maintained RAC Total energy baseline.
Encode 2RES2VE300UA2 F010 schedule times as UTC; status byte 30 maps 2 to sunrise/sunset and 3 to the user schedule, and persist user-entered local times across restarts.
Only expose the observed discrete F010 brightness values 0, 10, 30, 50, 80, and 100; keep 30 as the default and reject arbitrary MQTT values.
Treat the F017 ACK as receipt only; publish Smart Care+ state from status offset 17 in 10EB or 10EC, because an accepted command may not transition while the appliance is busy.
